source: Research-informed practice examples; DB master is authoritative at runtime

items.name: Underlayment
items.notes: Synthetic underlay; overlaps represented only as practice allowance; user must replace with roll yield.

items.name: Architectural field shingles
items.notes: Example architectural shingles. Field labour covers ordinary fixing; does not include strip-off or deck repairs.

items.name: Ridge cap shingles
items.notes: Horizontal ridgeline; sample rate allocated from cap bundles.

items.name: Hip cap shingles
items.notes: Diagonal hips; sample hip cap cost distinct from ridge labour.

items.name: Valley protection
items.notes: Example self-adhered valley membrane, priced by installed valley metre; check actual membrane width and overlaps.

items.name: Rake starter / verge edge
items.notes: Rake starter course only; not an eaves drip edge. Add eaves detail separately if required.

items.name: Shingle nails allowance
items.notes: Material-only nails allowance by surface area; fastening labour is included in field shingles (intentional $0 here).

items.name: Roofing underlay
items.notes: Underlay priced separately from sheeting.

items.name: Corrugated metal roof sheets
items.notes: Indicative coated steel coverage cost; effective cover width and custom sheet length not modelled in demo.

items.name: Ridge flashing
items.notes: Horizontal ridge only.

items.name: Hip flashing
items.notes: Conventional diagonal hip; use hip/valley length factor on plan measurements.

items.name: Valley flashing
items.notes: Folded valley tray; verify actual cross section.

items.name: Barge / rake flashing
items.notes: Sloping gable edge; rafter pitch for plan length only.

items.name: Roofing screws allowance
items.notes: Screw cost by roof area for demonstration; fixing labour included in roof sheet labour; wind-zone count not assumed.

libraries.name: Concrete Tile Roofing
libraries.description: Standard interlocking concrete roof tile example

items.name: Tile underlay
items.notes: Example underlay; verify actual weathering membrane.

items.name: Concrete field tiles
items.notes: Example interlocking concrete tile installed surface. Includes standard handling and placement labour.

items.name: Tile battens allowance
items.notes: Area-based batten allowance for demo; not a supplier linear-metre order and not a fixing schedule.

items.name: Ridge tiles
items.notes: Horizontal ridge; assumed standard caps and fixing consumables.

items.name: Hip tiles
items.notes: Diagonal hip; distinct labour from ridge.

items.name: Valley tray
items.notes: Metal valley tray, not individual valley tiles.

items.name: Verge / gable finish
items.notes: Sloping verge; choose dry verge or other detail in real component.

items.name: Tile fixing clips allowance
items.notes: Illustrative clips per roof surface; installation labour is included in field tile labour.

items.name: Slate underlay
items.notes: Example high-quality roof underlay.

items.name: Natural slate field covering
items.notes: Natural slate covering. Slate dimensions, exposure, shipping breakage and cut waste affect actual cost.

items.name: Slate battens allowance
items.notes: Area-based batten cost for demo, not measured lengths or ordering quantities.

items.name: Slate ridge finish
items.notes: Example ridge finish; slate or metal ridge methods vary.

items.name: Slate hip finish
items.notes: Conventional diagonal hip; specialist slate trimming.

items.name: Slate valley flashing
items.notes: Metal valley example for natural slate.

items.name: Slate verge / rake finish
items.notes: Sloping rake detail; evaluate actual slate cutwork.

items.name: Slate nails / hooks allowance
items.notes: Material-only fixing allowance; fixing labour is included in slate field labour.

items.name: Polyiso insulation allowance
items.notes: Sample thermal layer allowance; deck profile and insulation thickness must be checked. Surface area assumed measured directly.

items.name: 60 mil TPO membrane
items.notes: Mechanically attached membrane example; seams priced separately. Measured surface area directly, no steep-roof pitch factor.

items.name: Field seam welding
items.notes: Heat-welded TPO seam; seam lengths require independent takeoff, not roof area.

items.name: Perimeter termination
items.notes: Perimeter bar/seal termination; measure actual perimeter run.

items.name: Attachment plates and fasteners allowance
items.notes: Material allowance for mechanical fixation; fixing labour included in membrane labour; no uplift design.
